The Motto clear aligner process When you visit our Phoenix, AZ office for clear aligners, our Motto care team makes the process simple and doctor-directed. From your first consultation to your new smile, here’s what you can expect: 1 Get your custom treatment plan At your first visit, your provider will complete a dental exam, take X-rays, and perform a 3D scan to ensure you’re a good candidate for clear aligners. You'll see a digital preview of your future smile and receive a personalized, doctor-directed treatment plan—all in one appointment. 2 Wear your clear aligners Each set of aligners is worn for a prescribed time to gradually move your teeth into place. With routine check-ins from your provider, we monitor your progress and make sure your clear aligner treatment stays on track for the best results. 3 Reveal your new smile In as little as 6 months, you could see your final clear aligner results. After treatment, we’ll fit you for a custom retainer and send you home with a free whitening kit ($198 value). Plus, you’ll get long-term care tips to help you maintain your straighter, brighter smile. Expert clear aligner care in Phoenix, AZ Expertly trained doctors Your doctor is expertly trained with the highest standards and consistency. That means all Motto smiles are in great hands no matter your location. Clinical oversight from start to finish Your provider helps evaluate your smile, guide your treatment plan and monitor progress along the way. Local care when you need it Your Aspen Dental care team in Phoenix provides in-person support and treatment customized to your smile. At Aspen Dental, our general dentistry services cover everything from checkups to fillings—so getting your oral health needs met has never been easier. Understanding general dentistry services General dentistry includes the everyday dental care that helps keep your mouth healthy. Think preventative teeth cleanings, dental fillings, root canal treatment and more. These services are the foundation of long-term oral health —and at Aspen Dental, we’re here to help you stay ahead of dental issues and feel confident in your care every step of the way. Comprehensive general dentistry services for every smile From preventive treatments to cosmetic touch-ups , our dentistry services are designed to meet your needs today—and protect your smile for tomorrow. Dental exams Your first dental checkup includes X-rays, an oral health assessment, oral cancer screening and your customized care plan. east Teeth cleaning After your checkup, we'll schedule your preventative teeth cleaning to keep your health on track. For oral health maintenance, schedule twice per year. east Dental fillings If you’re dealing with a sensitive tooth due to a cavity, a dental filling is an easy and cost-effective way to address it—and prevent it from getting worse. east Teeth whitening From in-office teeth whitening solutions to convenient take-home kits, your care team will help you find the brighter side of your smile. east arrow_back arrow_forward Restorative dental services If damage, tooth decay or pain is getting in the way of your smile, restorative care can help bring it back. Preview your smile Frequently asked questions about general dentistry services How often should I get my teeth cleaned? add_circle_outline We typically recommend routine preventative teeth cleaning every 6 months. For some, it can be more. These regular visits help remove plaque and tartar , prevent cavities and gum disease and keep your breath fresh. Staying on schedule with your hygiene appointments makes it easier to avoid bigger, more costly problems down the road. How can I pay for general dentistry services without insurance? add_circle_outline You have options. Aspen Dental accepts cash, credit cards and 3rd-party financing —and 99% of patients are approved for financing when they apply through 3rd party lenders. That means you can move forward with general dentistry services right away, even if you don’t have insurance. No insurance? No worries. enroll in the Aspen Dental Savings Plan ³ for an annual $49 fee and enjoy unlimited savings on the dental care you need. ³The Aspen Dental Savings Plan is NOT insurance. Please see plan terms and conditions for details. Are dental cleanings painful? add_circle_outline Generally, no. For most patients, hygiene services (dental cleaning) is simple and comfortable. If it’s been a while, you may feel a little sensitivity , but your hygienist can offer numbing options if needed. Regular cleanings every 6 months keep your visits easy and your smile healthy. What counts as a dental emergency? add_circle_outline A dental emergency includes severe tooth pain, a knocked-out or broken tooth , an infection with swelling or uncontrolled bleeding. Issues like minor chips or mild sensitivity usually aren’t emergencies, but if you’re unsure, schedule an appointment with Aspen Dental . We offer same-day emergency care when you need it most. Should I go to the ER or a dentist for dental emergencies? add_circle_outline See a dentist first for most urgent dental issues—like toothaches , infections or broken teeth . However, the ER is best option for serious trauma, uncontrolled bleeding or airway problems. Aspen Dental offices are equipped to handle most emergencies quickly and at a lower cost than an ER visit. When is a tooth extraction necessary? add_circle_outline A tooth extraction may be recommended if a tooth is too damaged, decayed or infected to save. It may also be needed if a tooth is fractured, impacted or causing crowding . Your Aspen Dental dentist will explain your options and talk with you about tooth replacements like implants , bridges or dentures . How painful is a root canal and how do I recover? add_circle_outline A root canal sounds intimidating, but it shouldn’t be painful. With local anesthesia, the procedure feels like getting a filling. Afterward, you may notice mild soreness for a few days, which can usually be managed with over-the-counter pain relief. How is periodontal (gum) disease treated? add_circle_outline Periodontal disease treatment depends on the stage of the disease . Early gum disease can often be managed with preventative dental cleaning and improved home care. More advanced cases may need scaling and root planing (deep cleaning), antibiotics or gum surgery. At Aspen Dental, we’ll create a treatment plan that helps restore your gum health and protects your smile.
